actions.label: Validate manifest
actions.description: Check that the distribution manifest is valid.
actions.agent: Validate the distribution manifest and say whether it is valid. Read-only.

manifest.label: Manifest
manifest.description: Path to the manifest. Defaults to distribution/apple-distribution.json.

ok.label: Valid
ok.description: True when the manifest is valid.

actions.label: Check App Store Connect access
actions.description: Check that the App Store Connect API credentials work.
actions.agent: Verify App Store Connect API credentials without printing secrets. Read-only.

config.label: Config
config.description: Path to the config file with the API key settings.

actions.label: App Review status
actions.description: See the App Review state of each version of the app.
actions.agent: Read the App Review state of every App Store version and review submission for one bundle id. Read-only.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: IOS or MAC_OS. Defaults to both.

config.label: Config
config.description: Path to the config file with the API key settings.

versions.label: Versions
versions.description: JSON: one entry per App Store version and review submission, with its state.

actions.label: Check third-party login
actions.description: Check that a third-party login offers Sign in with Apple before review.
actions.agent: Run the Guideline 4.8 pre-submission check on a project folder. Exits 1 on any finding. Read-only.

root.label: Project folder
root.description: The project folder to check. Defaults to the current folder.
